title: Artemis II Launch Viewership Sets Record: ~350,000 Spectators on Florida's Space Coast
detail: Nearly 350,000 spectators gathered along Florida's Space Coast to witness the Artemis II crewed lunar launch, setting a record for NASA mission in-person viewership. The mass turnout reflects surging public interest in human deep space exploration following the mission's successful crewed lunar flyby (April 1–10, 2026).
